project.task: k-hop pointer chasing over N=12 nodes; trained on k in {1,2,3,4}, evaluated on k in {1..4} (in-dist) and k in {5..8} (unseen depth extrapolation)

arms.aria_title: Looped Lab — Arm A: Standard 4-Layer Transformer
arms.question: Baseline fixed-depth circuit: 4 distinct untied blocks applied once.

arms.aria_title: Looped Lab — Arm B: Weight-Tied Looped (Fixed T=4)
arms.question: Isolates weight tying at equal compute: 1 shared block applied 4 times (~3.7x fewer parameters).

arms.aria_title: Looped Lab — Arm C: Adaptive Test-Time Loops (T=k up to 8)
arms.question: Tests dialing extra loop iterations at inference on unseen 5..8 hop chains with zero emitted CoT tokens.

arms.aria_title: Looped Lab — Arm D: Think-Out-Loud Scratchpad CoT
arms.question: Standard causal model that writes every intermediate hop as an emitted token: readable by text monitors, k sequential decode steps.

shipped_models_fact_check.verified_details: 24-layer MoE (26.4B total, 3.4B active); middle 12 layers (blocks 2-3) run 3 times with shared weights for 48 layer applications per token. Companion variable-loop checkpoint studied serial reasoning out to 10 loops and CoT monitorability vs factual recall.

750B Loop Transformer adapting GLM-5 by looping 28 shared layers across 2 iterations with per-token gated progressive residual updates (to prevent activation-norm blowup) and a hybrid KV cache; controlled ablations published on a 30B test model.
No primary OpenAI publication confirms a looped-transformer architecture; omitted from factual claims.
